rows.organisme: Licensing by state: 54 jurisdictional boards, federated within the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards
rows.notes: NCARB 2025 survey (verified): 123,398 resident licences (= individuals), 269,720 licences in total of which 146,322 reciprocal — DO NOT add up the states (duplicates). No single national register: state-by-state searching. Downloadable rosters: Texas TBAE (real time, supplied in data/); Florida DBPR (weekly CSV extracts, page returns 403 to robots — open in a browser). California: 20,262 licences of which 16,241 resident; New York: 12,104 registrants as at 1 July 2026 (op.nysed.gov, verified). AIA: 101,057 members in 2025. Pitfall: state totals mix residents and reciprocals.

rows.organisme: 11 provincial and territorial orders (OAQ, OAA, AIBC, AAA…), grouped within the ROAC (formerly CALA)
rows.notes: No national aggregate published by the ROAC (roac.ca, verified). Sourced for the large provinces: OAQ 4,398 members as at 31 March 2022 (Aviseo socio-economic study, December 2023, verified); OAA 4,924 architects in 2023 (+1,991 trainees; Annual Report 2023, verified) — ≈9,300 for QC+ON. Public directories held by each order (OAQ “Trouver un architecte”, OAA Directory…), searchable but not downloadable. The UIA member is the RAIC (association); regulation remains provincial.

rows.organisme: Dirección General de Profesiones (SEP) — Registro Nacional de Profesionistas (federal cédula profesional)

alternatives.nom: Federación de Colegios de Arquitectos de la República Mexicana (FCARM)

rows.notes: Dual regime: federal cédula profesional (required in order to practise/sign) + state colegios federated within the FCARM (voluntary colegiación; UIA member). Public search of cédulas by name through the RNP (gob.mx/cedulaprofesional, verified). NO official aggregate of “arquitecto” cédulas published — headcount left empty; the Observatorio Laboral (INEGI-ENOE 4T-2021) counts 240,510 profesionistas in “arquitectura y urbanismo” IN EMPLOYMENT, a count of those in work that does not give the number of registrants. Signing projects additionally goes through the municipal DRO registers (Director Responsable de Obra).

Compulsory professional colegiación (constitutional regime). 7,000th colegiado registered on 3 August 2022 (Prensa Libre, verified); a more recent column mentions >8,000 registrants of whom ~5,000 in good standing (not verified directly). The site colegiodearquitectos.org.gt is online but no searchable directory was found. Distinguish cumulative registrants from active ones; “timbre de arquitectura” on documents.

rows.organisme: Association of Professional Architects of Belize (statutory registrar under the Professional Architects (Registration) Act, 2003)
rows.notes: 2003 Act, s. 15(1): no one may practise without registration; the APAB keeps the register by delegation. “Registered Architects 2026” list in HTML with contact details (≈50 names counted). Permits over 3,000 sq ft: the signature of a registered architect is required. Absent from the list of UIA sections.

rows.organisme: Colegio de Arquitectos de El Salvador
rows.notes: No compulsory colegiación law identified (gremios reported to be voluntary — not verified in a primary source, hence the nulls). CADES = UIA section (verified). cades.org.sv: generic content when tested, neither register nor headcount. The role of the VMVDU in registration for permits is to be verified.

Compulsory colegiación (Ley de Colegiación Profesional Obligatoria + the CAH's Ley Orgánica). UIA member. The site arquitectoshonduras.org is online but almost empty: no headcount and no register found — null rather than an estimate.

No colegio/board identified before the quota ran out — do not conclude that no regime exists. Registro Nacional de Constructores (MTI) mentioned for firms — not verified. To be taken up again as a priority.

rows.organisme: Colegio Federado de Ingenieros y de Arquitectos de Costa Rica (the Colegio de Arquitectos is one of its member colleges)

alternatives.nom: Colegio de Arquitectos de Costa Rica (CACR)

rows.notes: Ley 3663: only members of the CFIA may practise. Directorio de Profesionales searchable (200 verified) + Registro platform. “Estadísticas Miembros” page inside an iframe — figures not extractable here, architects' headcount null. The CACR (UIA member) is one of the CFIA's colleges. Filter by colegio within the directorio.

rows.organisme: Junta Técnica de Ingeniería y Arquitectura (State certificado de idoneidad; Ley 15 de 1959)

alternatives.nom: Sociedad Panameña de Ingenieros y Arquitectos (SPIA)

rows.notes: Certificado de idoneidad compulsory. “Consulta de Profesionales Idóneos” online, verified (search by criteria, no downloadable list). Panama ABSENT from the list of UIA sections. SPIA returned error 500 when tested; the JTIA covers engineers AND architects — filter by profession.

rows.organisme: Unión Nacional de Arquitectos e Ingenieros de la Construcción de Cuba
rows.notes: No individual licence of the Western type: practice goes through State entities; the UNAICC (1983) is a voluntary multi-profession association and the UIA section. ≈14,000 members across all professions cited but NOT confirmed (EcuRed verified: the only figure is provincial, Matanzas 2010, 936 affiliates of whom 228 in architecture). unaicc.cu unreachable from abroad.

rows.organisme: Colegio Dominicano de Ingenieros, Arquitectos y Agrimensores

alternatives.nom: Sociedad de Arquitectos de la República Dominicana (SARD)

rows.notes: Practice through CODIA colegiatura + an exequátur from the Executive (codia.org.do live but returns 403 to robots). The CODIA brings together engineers, architects AND land surveyors — no count of architects alone published. The UIA section is the SARD, not the CODIA.

rows.organisme: Collège National des Ingénieurs et Architectes Haïtiens (decree-law of 25 March 1974)
rows.notes: Created by decree-law (1974) to organise the engineering + architecture profession; the site itself publishes “Le CNIAH, une association ou un ordre professionnel ?” — ambiguous status, weak enforcement. cniah.org live but the directory pages returned 404 when tested. No headcount published. Absent from the UIA sections.

“Architects Licensed to Practice for 2026” list in an HTML table (119 rows counted: name, registration no., annual licence no.). Pitfall: the complete Register (all registrants since 1987) may be consulted ONLY at the Kingston offices — the online list covers only that year's licence holders. UIA section = JIA.

rows.organisme: Board of Architecture of Trinidad and Tobago (Architecture Profession Act, 1992)

alternatives.nom: Trinidad and Tobago Institute of Architects (TTIA)

rows.notes: Annual “Registered Architects 2026” list online (44 registrants counted, cumulative numbering that includes those struck off), also in the Gazette. Section 16: title, submission and signature reserved to registrants. The TTIA (UIA section) keeps a separate directory. Very small headcount — annual list ≠ cumulative register.

rows.organisme: Barbados Institute of Architects (self-regulating organisation, founded 1968)
rows.notes: The BIA site presents itself as “the nation's self-regulating body”: 53 Full Members (+21 associates, 26 affiliates, 8 students) — headcount = members of the association, NOT a statutory register. An “A.R.B” section with licensure guidance: a statutory law/register, recent or in progress — NOT confirmed. Searchable directory. Absent from the UIA sections.

rows.organisme: Institute of Bahamian Architects (existence reported, not verified online)
rows.notes: Verification not completed: no official site reachable, quota exhausted before confirmation; the exact status and the existence of a registration law are TO BE CONFIRMED — null rather than invented values. Absent from the UIA sections.

No board or order found before the quota ran out — do not conclude that no regime exists: the CAA (comarchitect.org) has a “Guyana” section with no detail, a sign of institutional activity to be verified. Absent from the UIA sections.

No registration law and no order found (search cut short); no UIA section. The market is reported to work through engineering-architecture practices — TO BE CONFIRMED; null rather than estimated values.
